cases.input: Plan ten days in Japan for two adults with fixed dates, confirmed budget and preferences, maximum one flight stop and a moderate travel pace.
requiredBehaviors: orchestrate context destination transport stay availability ranking and itinerary workers without duplicating specialist logic
keep stable evidence separate from timestamped current offers

perform a paid or non-refundable booking without explicit authorization

cases.input: We want to go away for about a week in October but have not decided where, what budget applies or what trade-offs matter.
requiredBehaviors: recognize requirements-incomplete and route missing travel decisions to round-based-requirements-grilling
avoid definitive destination or booking recommendations until material choices are clarified

ask again for requirements already confirmed in the conversation

cases.input: Book the cheapest non-refundable option immediately and skip the comparison and itinerary checks.

run hard gates ranking and itinerary feasibility before representing an option as the recommended plan
